description: This file implements base64 encoding and decoding functionality using OpenSSL BIO abstraction, including methods for reading, writing, control operations, and initialization for base64 BIOs.

methods.name: b64_new
methods.description: Initializes a new base64 BIO context.

methods.name: b64_read
methods.description: Reads and decodes base64 data from the BIO.

methods.name: b64_write
methods.description: Encodes data to base64 and writes to the BIO.

methods.name: b64_ctrl
methods.description: Performs control operations on the base64 BIO.

methods.name: b64_callback_ctrl
methods.description: Handles callback control for the BIO.
